title: Baljeet Singh v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: V.K. Shukla, J.; Ashok Kumar, J.
disposition: Mandamus refused; apply for permanent disconnection as per Code
headnote: Mandamus directing permanent disconnection of supply cannot issue where the consumer has not applied in the prescribed format after depositing the requisite amount under the Electricity Act, 2003 read with the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ was not entertained; the petitioner was left free to make a complete application, to be dealt with strictly as per that law.
facts: Baljeet Singh sought a High Court direction to disconnect his electricity connection at village Neemka, Police Station Parikshitgarh, Tehsil Mawana, District Meerut. The electricity department submitted that he had not applied for permanent disconnection in the prescribed format after depositing the requisite amount. Counsel for the petitioner accepted that, under the Electricity Act, 2003 read with the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, no complete application had been moved, the petitioner having only filed an application on 9 February 2017.

holding_units.topic: permanent disconnection — prescribed application before mandamus
holding_units.holding: A writ of mandamus directing permanent disconnection of an electricity connection cannot issue where the consumer has not applied in the prescribed format after depositing the requisite amount under the Electricity Act, 2003 (styled in the order as the Electricity Supply Act, 2003) read with the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The consumer remains free to make a complete application, which must then be dealt with strictly in accordance with that law.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner’s electricity connection ought to be permanently disconnected
not_decided.note: Writ not entertained on the incomplete application; petitioner left to apply in the prescribed form, to be dealt with as per the Act and Code.
